summary: [para 11] 11. The capital cost of the transmission asset has been calculated in accordance with Regulations 19(1) and 19(3) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. [para 13] 13. The Petitioner in the instant true-up Petition vide affidavit dated 30.12.2025, has claimed the following revised capital cost and ACE with respect to the transmission asset for the 2019-24 tariff period: [para 14] 14. We have considered the Petitioner’s submission. The trued-up capital cost has been calculated in accordance with Regulation 19(1) and 19(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. The Petitioner vide the Auditor’s Certificate dated 7.10.2024, has claimed the capital cost of ₹13828.49 lakh as on COD. Accordingly, the same is being considered as the opening capital cost, subject to adjustment on account of undischarged IDC and grant received till COD, with respect to the instant transmission asset for truing up of the Annual fixed charges (AFC) for the 2019-24 tariff period. [para 20] 20. We have considered both the Petitioner and MPPMCL’s submissions. Regulation 19(5) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations provides for the exclusion of the grant (from the capital cost) received from the Central or State Government or any statutory body or authority for the execution of the transmission project, which does not carry any liability of repayment. [para 44] 44. Accordingly, the details of the trued-up capital cost and ACE approved with respect to the transmission asset for the 2019-24 tariff period are as follows: [para 103] 103. The Petitioner has submitted that as per Regulation 36(3)(d) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the security expenses and capital spares of more than ₹10 lakh for the transmission system shall be allowed separately after a prudence check. [para 109] 109. On perusal of Regulation 36(3)(d) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations and considering the Petitioner’s submissions, the Petitioner is allowed to file a single consolidated Petition comprising of security expenses, capital spares individually costing more than ₹10 lakh and insurance expenses, on an estimated basis in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period. [¶] for arrears of the transmission charges determined through this order shall be computed DIC-wise in accordance with the provisions of respective sharing Regulations and shall be recovered from the concerned DICs through Bills under Regulation 15(2)(b) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations. The billing, collection and disbursement of the transmission charges with respect to the transmission asset shall be recovered in terms of provisions of the 2020 Sharing Regulations as provided in Regulation 57 of the 2019 Tariff Regulations for the 2019-24 tariff period and Regulation 78 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period.
